lines.text: She, not he, for a woman!
Many learners say: My sister is a nurse. He works hard.
Better: My sister is a nurse. She works hard.
She! My mother is kind. She helps me.

data.wrong: My sister is a nurse. He works hard.
data.right: My sister is a nurse. She works hard.

quiz.stem: My mother is kind. ___ helps me.

native.tip: Türkçede “o” hem kadın hem erkek için geçer; İngilizcede kadın için “she” kullanılır.
native.caption: “My sister is a nurse. He works hard.” mi diyorsun? 😅 Doğrusu “My sister is a nurse. She works hard.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “She”. Kadından söz ederken she denir. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: Turkish “o” is for both, but English has he and she.
en.caption: Do you say “My sister is a nurse. He works hard.”? 😅 English uses she for a woman. The right sentence is “My sister is a nurse. She works hard.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
